    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

        s.a1 AS start_atom,

        p.start_atom,
        sb.a2 AS cur_atom,

        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM molecule
        WHERE label = '+'
    ),
    edges AS (
        SELECT a.atom_id AS from_atom,
               a2.atom_id AS to_atom
        FROM connected c
        JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
        JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
          AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carc_mol)
          AND a2.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    ),
    paths AS (
        SELECT e.from_atom AS start_atom,
               e.from_atom || ',' AS visited,
               0 AS length,
               e.from_atom AS last_atom
        FROM edges e
        UNION ALL
        SELECT p.start_atom,
               p.visited || e.to_atom || ',',
               p.length + 1,
               e.to_atom
        FROM paths p
        JOIN edges e ON p.last_atom = e.from_atom
        WHERE ',' || p.visited || ',' NOT LIKE '%,' || e.to_atom || ',%'
    ),
    best_path AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM paths
        ORDER BY length DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ),
    split AS (
        SELECT
            SUBSTR(bp.visited, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(bp.visited, ',')>0 THEN INSTR(bp.visited, ',')-1 ELSE LENGTH(bp.visited) END) AS atom,
            SUBSTR(bp.visited, CASE WHEN INSTR(bp.visited, ',')>0 THEN INSTR(bp.visited, ',')+1 ELSE 0 END) AS remaining
        FROM best_path bp
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            SUBSTR(s.remaining, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(s.remaining, ',')>0 THEN INSTR(s.remaining, ',')-1 ELSE LENGTH(s.remaining) END),
            SUBSTR(s.remaining, CASE WHEN INSTR(s.remaining, ',')>0 THEN INSTR(s.remaining, ',')+1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM split s
        WHERE s.remaining != ''
    )
    SELECT atom
    FROM split
    WHERE atom <> '';
}

WITH bond_counts AS (

    FROM connected
    GROUP BY atom_id

    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.molecule_id ORDER BY COALESCE(bc.bond_cnt, 0) DESC) AS rank

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

ORDER BY rank;

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH atom_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.atom_id,
        a.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'n'
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
),
ranked_atoms AS (
    SELECT 
        abc.atom_id,
        abc.molecule_id,
        abc.bond_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abc.molecule_id ORDER BY abc.bond_count DESC, abc.atom_id) AS rn
    FROM atom_bond_counts abc
),
top3_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id, molecule_id, bond_count
    FROM ranked_atoms
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    t.atom_id,
    t.molecule_id,
    b.bond_type
FROM top3_atoms t
JOIN connected c ON t.atom_id = c.atom_id

questions.nlq: Could you tell me the atom ID for each bond that is part of the longest path in its molecule?

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The atom ID refers to the identifier of the first atom listed in the bond pair.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
  edges AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id,
           a.atom_id AS from_atom,
           b.atom_id AS to_atom,
           c.bond_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    JOIN atom b ON c.atom_id2 = b.atom_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  ),
  paths AS (
    SELECT
      a.molecule_id,
      a.atom_id AS cur_atom,
      ','||a.atom_id||',' AS visited_atoms,
      '' AS visited_bonds,
      0 AS depth
    FROM atom a
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      e.molecule_id,
      e.to_atom,
      p.visited_atoms||e.to_atom||',',
      CASE WHEN p.visited_bonds = '' THEN e.bond_id
           ELSE p.visited_bonds||','||e.bond_id END,
      p.depth+1
    FROM paths p
    JOIN edges e ON p.cur_atom = e.from_atom AND p.molecule_id = e.molecule_id
    WHERE instr(p.visited_atoms, ','||e.to_atom||',') = 0
  ),
  max_len AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, MAX(depth) AS max_depth
    FROM paths
    GROUP BY molecule_id
  ),
  longest_paths AS (
    SELECT p.molecule_id, p.visited_bonds
    FROM paths p
    JOIN max_len m ON p.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND p.depth = m.max_depth
  )
  SELECT DISTINCT
         SUBSTR(b.bond_id, 1, instr(b.bond_id, '_', instr(b.bond_id, '_')+1)-1) AS atom_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN longest_paths lp ON b.molecule_id = lp.molecule_id
  WHERE ','||lp.visited_bonds||',' LIKE '%,'||b.bond_id||',%'

WITH
edges AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id,
         c.atom_id AS a1,
         c.atom_id2 AS a2,
         b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
),
paths AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id AS start_atom,
    a.atom_id AS current_atom,
    ',' || a.atom_id || ',' AS visited,
    '' AS bond_list,
    0 AS length,
    a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.start_atom,
    CASE WHEN p.current_atom = e.a1 THEN e.a2 ELSE e.a1 END AS current_atom,
    p.visited ||
      CASE WHEN p.current_atom = e.a1 THEN e.a2 ELSE e.a1 END || ',' AS visited,
    p.bond_list ||
      CASE WHEN p.bond_list = '' THEN '' ELSE ',' END ||
      e.bond_id AS bond_list,
    p.length + 1 AS length,
    p.molecule_id
  FROM paths p
  JOIN edges e ON
    ( (p.current_atom = e.a1 AND NOT (p.visited LIKE ('%,'||e.a2||',%'))) OR
      (p.current_atom = e.a2 AND NOT (p.visited LIKE ('%,'||e.a1||',%')) )
    )
    AND p.molecule_id = e.molecule_id
),
max_len AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, MAX(length) AS max_len
  FROM paths
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
split AS (
  SELECT
    p.molecule_id,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(p.bond_list, ',') = 0 THEN p.bond_list
      ELSE substr(p.bond_list, 1, instr(p.bond_list, ',')-1)
    END AS bond_id,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(p.bond_list, ',') = 0 THEN ''
      ELSE substr(p.bond_list, instr(p.bond_list, ',')+1)
    END AS rest
  FROM paths p
  JOIN max_len m ON p.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND p.length = m.max_len
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(rest, ',') = 0 THEN rest
      ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',')-1)
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(rest, ',') = 0 THEN ''
      ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, ',')+1)
    END
  FROM split
  WHERE rest != ''
),
result AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    SUBSTR(bond_id,
           instr(bond_id, '_', instr(bond_id, '_', 1) + 1) + 1) AS atom_id
  FROM split
)
